title: Logspace membership of the comparison language
statement: For any two Boolean values $a$ and $b$, the language of bit strings of the form $\langle 1^n,\operatorname{bits}(i)\rangle$ for which either $i<n$ and $a$ is true, or $i=n$ and $b$ is true, is decidable in logarithmic space. Here $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$ is the self-delimiting pair encoding.
